zh.summary: 全球市場在[[key:AI科技]]帶動下呈現[[pos:看漲情緒]]，但[[warn:通膨擔憂]]及債券拋售帶來潛在風險。許多科技巨頭如NVIDIA、AMD等仍保有[[key:高波動性]]，提供賣方策略的優渥溢價。建議首選[[pos:賣出認售]]策略，鎖定如MSFT和GOOG等具有[[pos:強勁基本面]]且下方支撐明確的標的。對於高波動股，謹慎運用賣出認購策略。整體而言，市場雖有變數，但仍可尋得[[pos:穩定收益]]機會。
zh.TSLA: TSLA IV中等。市場傾向區間震盪，[[warn:中國市場]]壓力是主要風險。建議Sell Call $310，利用上方阻力收取溢價，距離現價275約+12.7%。關鍵風險在於[[neg:銷售數據]]不如預期，或地緣政治引發波動。
zh.NVDA: NVDA具[[key:高IV]]，即將迎來財報，市場[[pos:極度看漲]]。建議Sell Put $195（假設現價$200），利用其強勁上升趨勢收取溢價。然而，[[warn:財報波動]]是最大風險，可能導致快速下跌。
zh.AAPL: AAPL IV中等，基本面[[pos:穩健]]。阻力位在$310（假設現價$285.66）。建議Sell Put $275，利用其下方的強勁支撐。主要風險來自[[warn:科技股監管]]政策或iPhone銷售放緩。
zh.AMZN: AMZN IV中等偏高，P/C OI比顯示[[pos:看漲情緒]]。Sell Put $260，此為Max Pain及最大認售OI支撐。需留意[[warn:AI治理]]相關的負面消息及[[key:法律糾紛]]。
zh.AMD: AMD具[[key:高IV]]，近期晶片股有回落跡象。P/C OI比近中性。Sell Call $460，鎖定上方阻力獲取高溢價，距離現價$424.10約+8.5%。[[warn:晶片股修正]]是主要風險。
zh.META: META IV中等，P/C OI比強烈[[pos:看漲]]。[[key:獲利創紀錄]]顯示基本面強勁。建議Sell Put $600，利用其強力支撐，距離現價$614.23約-2.3%。潛在風險為[[warn:廣告收入]]成長放緩。
zh.MSFT: MSFT IV中等，P/C OI比[[pos:強勁看漲]]。下方有$375的穩固支撐。建議Sell Put $400，安全邊際較高，距離現價$421.92約-5.2%。[[warn:巨頭拋售]]可能引發短期波動。
zh.GOOG: GOOG IV中等，P/C OI比偏[[pos:看漲]]。Max Pain在$370，形成強大支撐。建議Sell Put $370，安全且有穩定溢價，距離現價$393.32約-5.9%。需留意[[warn:廣告收入]]成長變化。
zh.AMC: AMC具[[key:極端高IV]]，[[key:迷因股]]性質，股價[[warn:極端波動]]。Max Pain $2。建議Sell Call $2.50，高溢價，但風險極高。現價$1.28，慎防[[warn:劇烈軋空]]。
zh.PLTR: PLTR具[[key:高IV]]，[[pos:財報亮眼]]並獲川普加持。P/C OI比偏看漲。建議Sell Put $130，利用市場看好情緒，距離現價$133.99約-3.0%。風險點在於[[warn:估值壓力]]。
zh.COIN: COIN具[[key:非常高IV]]，受惠[[pos:加密法案]]利好。Max Pain $200。建議Sell Call $220，鎖定上方波動獲取高溢價，距離現價$195.43約+12.6%。[[warn:估值過高]]和加密貨幣波動是主要風險。
zh.NFLX: NFLX IV中高，P/C OI比[[pos:強勁看漲]]。廣告業務增長[[key:前景樂觀]]。建議Sell Put $85，利用下方強勁支撐，距離現價$87.02約-2.3%。[[warn:串流競爭]]激烈是長期風險。
zh.BABA: BABA IV中高，P/C OI比[[pos:非常看漲]]，但新聞有[[neg:利潤下滑]]警示。Max Call OI $160形成阻力。建議Sell Call $150，謹慎應對，距離現價$132.59約+13.1%。[[warn:中國政策]]風險是關鍵。
zh.BAC: BAC IV偏低，P/C OI比中性。作為[[key:巴菲特愛股]]，股價相對[[pos:穩定]]。建議Sell Put $48，利用下方支撐，距離現價$49.77約-3.6%。[[warn:利率環境]]變化是主要風險。
zh.F: F IV中高，受[[pos:電池儲能]]利好，但AI漲勢[[neg:快速消退]]。P/C OI比強勁看漲。建議Sell Put $12，在Max Pain附近獲取溢價，距離現價$13.40約-10.4%。[[warn:電動車競爭]]激烈。
zh.BA: BA IV中等，受惠[[pos:中國大單]]利好。P/C OI比強勁看漲。Max Pain $230。建議Sell Put $220，利用看漲趨勢，距離現價$220.49約-0.2%。[[warn:供應鏈問題]]及品質控制仍是風險。
zh.INTC: INTC具[[key:非常高IV]]，P/C OI比[[neg:明顯看跌]]。近期晶片股回落。建議Sell Call $120，利用高溢價，距離現價$108.77約+10.3%。[[warn:晶片競爭]]激烈和[[key:市場份額]]流失是主要風險。
zh.GME: GME具[[key:極端高IV]]，[[key:迷因股]]特性，價格[[warn:劇烈波動]]。P/C OI比非常看漲。Max Pain $23，高於現價。建議Sell Put $20，博取反彈，距離現價$21.59約-7.4%。[[warn:情緒驅動]]，謹慎操作。
zh.DIS: DIS IV偏低，P/C OI比略偏看跌，但[[pos:財報強勁]]。Max Call OI $109為阻力。建議Sell Call $109，利用上方阻力，距離現價$102.72約+6.1%。[[warn:串流訂閱]]增長放緩是長期隱憂。
zh.JPM: JPM IV偏低，P/C OI比[[pos:強勁看漲]]。作為[[key:金融巨頭]]，市場地位穩固。建議Sell Put $290，在下方支撐位，距離現價$297.81約-2.6%。[[warn:利率環境]]和經濟前景變化是風險。

en.summary: Overall market sentiment today, May 16, 2026, appears [[key:mixed but generally resilient]], driven by AI momentum in a tech-led market, yet tempered by [[warn:inflation fears]] and rising bond yields. Nvidia's market cap surpassing Germany highlights the AI boom. However, sectors like autos face [[warn:China market uncertainties]] or volatility. Key Implied Volatility (IV) levels range from moderate 20-40% for established giants, to [[key:extremely high IV (>100%)]] for meme stocks like AMC and GME, presenting significant premium opportunities. Top trade setups include [[pos:Sell Puts on AMZN ($260)]] due to its strong bullish P/C OI, and [[pos:Sell Calls on AMC ($2.50+)]] to exploit extremely high IV. [[neg:Chip stocks retreated]] overall, indicating caution.
en.TSLA: Current IV is moderate (~23-33%). Given the resistance at [[key:$310]] and recent [[warn:China sales decline]], a Sell Call strategy is preferred. Target strikes slightly above $310. Risk: continued pressure in the Chinese market.
en.NVDA: IV is moderate (~20-33%). With strong analyst sentiment and AI momentum, a Sell Put strategy is plausible, targeting support around [[key:$200]]. However, [[warn:earnings next week]] pose a significant risk of volatility.
en.AAPL: IV is moderate (~23-33%). With price near max pain and a P/C OI of 0.80, a range-bound strategy is indicated. Consider selling a Call spread above [[key:$310]] or a Put spread below $275. Risk: [[warn:General tech market volatility]].
en.AMZN: IV is moderate (~28-36%). The [[key:bullish P/C OI of 0.63]] and [[pos:support at $260]] suggest a Sell Put strategy. Target strikes around $260. Risk: potential impact from [[warn:AI governance backlash]] or consumer lawsuits.
en.AMD: [[key:High IV (67-71%)]] offers attractive premiums. Despite neutral P/C OI, the recent [[neg:chip stock retreat]] and price above max pain suggest selling Calls above [[key:$460]]. Risk: [[warn:sector-wide volatility]].
en.META: IV is moderate (~31-36%). The [[key:bullish P/C OI (0.55)]] and [[pos:strong Q1 earnings]] support a Sell Put strategy. Target strikes near [[key:$600]] support. Risk: potential [[warn:increased regulatory scrutiny]] on social media platforms.
en.MSFT: IV is moderate (~30-39%). The [[key:very bullish P/C OI (0.51)]] and a "Strong Buy" consensus make Sell Puts attractive. Aim for strikes around [[key:$400]] to capitalize on underlying strength. Risk: potential [[warn:wider tech market pullback]].
en.GOOG: IV is moderate (~34-35%). With a strong "Buy" consensus and [[pos:positive partnership news]], a Sell Put strategy targeting the [[key:$370]] support and max pain level is favored. Risk: potential [[warn:antitrust scrutiny]].
en.AMC: [[key:Extremely high IV (92-269%)]] makes this ideal for selling. Given the price is significantly below the [[key:$2 resistance/max pain]], a Sell Call strategy at higher strikes (e.g., $2.50-$3.00) is attractive. Risk: [[warn:unpredictable meme stock surges]].
en.PLTR: IV is moderate to high (~47-52%). With price at [[key:max pain ($134)]] and recent upgraded outlook, an Iron Condor strategy could be effective. Selling Calls above $140 and Puts around $120. Risk: [[warn:post-earnings fluctuations]] and ESG concerns.
en.COIN: [[key:High IV (72-141%)]] offers attractive premiums for selling. The [[key:bullish P/C OI (0.53)]] suggests a Sell Put strategy, targeting strikes around [[key:$180-$190]] below max pain. Risk: [[warn:stretched valuation]] and crypto price swings.
en.NFLX: IV is moderate (~29-43%). The [[key:very bullish P/C OI (0.49)]] and [[pos:strong ad business growth]] favor a Sell Put strategy. Target strikes near [[key:$87-$88]] (Put OI/Max Pain). Risk: [[warn:AI-driven valuation questions]] and competition.
en.BABA: IV is moderate to high (~40-58%). Despite an [[key:extremely bullish P/C OI (0.26)]], [[neg:Q4 profit decline]] and analyst trimming [[warn:pose a downside risk]]. Consider a cautious Sell Call strategy above [[key:$140]].
en.BAC: IV is moderate (~25-38%). With a neutral P/C OI and [[pos:positive tailwinds]] for banks from rising yields, a Sell Put strategy at the [[key:$48 support]] is suitable. Risk: [[warn:economic slowdown]] impacting loan demand.
en.F: [[key:High IV (41-60%)]] offers good premium. Despite recent [[warn:extreme volatility]], the very [[key:bullish P/C OI (0.32)]] and battery storage potential favor a Sell Put strategy around [[key:$12-$13]]. Risk: quick shifts in market sentiment.
en.BA: IV is moderate to high (~36-53%). [[pos:Positive news]] regarding [[key:China aircraft orders]] and a [[key:very bullish P/C OI (0.40)]] make Sell Puts attractive. Target strikes around [[key:$210-$220]]. Risk: potential [[warn:geopolitical shifts]] impacting trade.
en.INTC: [[key:Very high IV (83-158%)]] offers substantial premium. The [[key:bearish P/C OI (1.55)]] and recent [[neg:chip sector retreat]] favor a Sell Call strategy around [[key:$120-$125]]. Risk: [[warn:significant bearish sentiment]].
en.GME: [[key:Very high IV (43-110%)]] makes selling strategies lucrative. Despite the [[key:extremely bullish P/C OI (0.24)]], the price is below [[key:$23 max pain]]. A Sell Call strategy at strikes above [[key:$25]] is recommended. Risk: [[warn:unpredictable meme stock surges]].
en.DIS: IV is moderate (~25-29%). With [[pos:strong Q2 results]], a Sell Put strategy targeting [[key:$101 support]] could be suitable, despite a slightly neutral P/C OI (1.06). Risk: ongoing [[warn:legal battles]] and streaming competition.
en.JPM: IV is moderate (~25-40%). The [[key:very bullish P/C OI (0.44)]] and general [[pos:tailwinds for banks]] suggest a Sell Put strategy. Target strikes around [[key:$285-$290]]. Risk: potential [[warn:global bond market turbulence]].
